# Canberra: the capital of Australia

Published: 2024-05-01

Canberra is the capital city of Australia. It is the largest inland city in the country.

- Canberra is the capital city of Australia and the seat of its federal parliament.
- Canberra was selected as the site of the national capital in 1908.
- Canberra's population was about 456,000 at the 2021 census.
